title: The 99% Success Paradox: When Near-Perfect Retrieval Equals Random Selection
authors: Vyzantinos Repantis; Harshvardhan Singh; Tony Joseph; Cien Zhang; Akash Vishwakarma; Svetlana Karslioglu; Michael Wyatt Thot; Ameya Gawde
why_relevant: Introduces a chance-corrected retrieval selectivity metric (BoR) showing that high recall at large K can mask random-level retrieval, with downstream RAG accuracy degrading due to irrelevant context. Relevant to evaluation metrics for noisy retrieval and depth/K control.
why_not_or_caveat: Primarily an IR metric paper; RAG robustness discussion is secondary.
suggested_section: Evaluation and metrics for noisy retrieval
